must_have.title: Lead Capture Contact Form
must_have.description: Primary conversion mechanism: a contact/inquiry form that validates input and submits the lead to the Web3Forms email API, with success and error states. Also offers a WhatsApp deep-link as an alternative contact channel.
acceptance_criteria: Contact Person, Company, and Business Email are required; email must match a basic email pattern.
Phone/WhatsApp and Brief Message are optional; message is capped at 300 characters with a live counter.
Primary Focus is a select with four preset options (GRC Audit, Custom Dev, Architecture Consulting, SMB/SaaS).
On submit the form POSTs a JSON payload to https://api.web3forms.com/submit and shows an 'Inquiry Received' confirmation on success.
On API failure or network error a submit error message is shown and the form remains editable.
A 'Chat on WhatsApp' link opens a prefilled wa.me conversation in a new tab.

must_have.title: Site Navigation & Section Anchors
must_have.description: Fixed top navigation for the single-page site, with a scroll-reactive style change, in-page anchor links to each section, primary call-to-action buttons, and a responsive mobile/tablet menu.
acceptance_criteria: Navbar becomes opaque/blurred with a bottom border after the page is scrolled past ~60px.
Desktop nav links (About, Services, Methodology, Products, Contact) jump to their in-page anchors.
Clicking the logo smoothly scrolls to the top of the page.
On smaller viewports a hamburger toggles a full-width overlay menu that closes on link selection.
'Initiate Collaboration' and 'Market Reach' CTAs link to the Contact and Market sections.

must_have.title: Hero Landing & Value Proposition
must_have.description: Above-the-fold hero introducing the company with a looping cinematic video background, headline/subcopy, and scroll-driven fade/scale transitions.
acceptance_criteria: A muted, looping, autoplaying background video plays inline behind the hero.
Headline ('Building Software with Agentic AI') and supporting copy animate in on load.
Hero content fades and scales out as the user scrolls down.
Motion intensity is reduced when the user prefers reduced motion.
A desktop bottom navigation pill links to key section anchors.

should_have.title: Cinematic Loading Screen
should_have.description: Full-screen branded loading overlay gated on both asset readiness and a minimum display time, with a sequential logo-then-background fade-out.
acceptance_criteria: The overlay stays visible until the critical frame asset is ready AND a minimum 2.5s has elapsed.
The logo pulses (breathing opacity) while loading.
When loading completes the logo fades first, then the background fades ~600ms later.
Body scroll is locked while the overlay is visible and released afterward.

should_have.title: Services Scroll-Frame Animation
should_have.description: Scroll-scrubbed canvas playback of an 86-frame image sequence for the Services section, synchronized with two swapping text slides (Enterprise / Agentic AI) and a scroll progress bar.
acceptance_criteria: A canvas renders frames from an 86-image webp sequence driven by scroll position within a 200vh sticky section.
The first frame loads immediately to unblock the UI; remaining frames load lazily in background batches.
Text content swaps between the Enterprise and AI slides using scroll-threshold hysteresis that survives fast scrolling.
A progress bar reflects scroll progress through the section.
Signals asset readiness to the app so the loading screen can dismiss.

should_have.title: Methodology Scroll Experience
should_have.description: A tall sticky section presenting the company methodology as staged, cinematically-animated points over a parallax particle/nebula canvas background.
acceptance_criteria: Within a 400vh sticky section the intro title minimizes and four methodology points appear at successive scroll thresholds.
A canvas renders multi-layer parallax particles and nebula blobs responding to scroll and (on desktop) mouse position.
The particle render loop pauses when the canvas is scrolled off-screen.
Methodology point content (index, punchline, narrative, technical tag) is data-driven.

should_have.title: Proprietary Product Showcase
should_have.description: Data-driven product showcase that renders each product from a typed block model (heading, text, list, media, button) in an alternating split layout.
acceptance_criteria: Each product renders heading, description, feature list, media image, and a call-to-action button from its block data.
List item icons are resolved by name from an icon map, falling back to a default icon.
Cards alternate media/content sides based on their index.
Product content is sourced from a typed products data model.

should_have.title: SEO & Social Metadata
should_have.description: Document head metadata (title, description, keywords) plus Open Graph and Twitter card tags injected via react-helmet-async.
acceptance_criteria: Sets page title, meta description, and keywords with sensible defaults.
Emits Open Graph (type, url, title, description, image) tags.
Emits Twitter card (summary_large_image) tags.
Values are overridable via props.

should_have.title: Error Boundary Fallback
should_have.description: React error boundary wrapping the app that catches render-time errors and shows a branded recovery screen instead of a blank page.
acceptance_criteria: A thrown render error is caught and a branded 'System Interruption' fallback is displayed.
The error is logged to the console for diagnostics.
A 'Restart Protocols' button reloads the page.

could_have.title: About / Innovation DNA Section
could_have.description: Static informational section presenting the company's three pillars (Business Analyst, AI Architect Engineer, System Developer) with scroll-parallax card motion.
acceptance_criteria: Displays three pillar cards with tag, title, and descriptive copy.
Cards animate into view with staggered scroll-linked parallax offsets.

could_have.title: Market Reach Section
could_have.description: Static section contrasting the two target market segments (Mid-to-Large Enterprises vs SMB Consulting & SaaS) with imagery and engagement-method tags.
acceptance_criteria: Presents two market-segment cards with heading, description, and engagement-method chips.
Cards animate in on scroll into view.

could_have.title: Footer & Newsletter Field
could_have.description: Site footer with brand blurb, social/contact links, quick navigation columns, and a newsletter email input.
acceptance_criteria: Shows brand info, LinkedIn/GitHub/email/location links, and Products/Company link columns.
Renders a newsletter email input with a subscribe button.
could_have.note: The newsletter email input has no onSubmit/onClick handler in the code — it is currently non-functional UI, not a working subscription. The 'Products' footer links and legal links (Privacy/Terms/Cookies) point to '#' placeholders.
